mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand and confidence, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and reduces recession risk, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 2100.0 and RSAFS > 350000.0 in same month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in interaction-triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production below 95.0 (index 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, signaling weakening economic momentum and rising recession risk, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 95.0 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal produces positive returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 200.0 (index 1982-1984=100) signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain or raise interest rates, which increases equity discount rates and reduces forward returns on the S&P 500 over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative during CPIAUCSL > 200.0 periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to achieve Rank IC > 0.05 in 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption (proxy: RSAFS) combined with a rising unemployment rate signals weakening consumer demand and economic stress, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 340000.0 and UNRATE > 5.0 in same month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative in interaction-triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the joint signal has Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% and a decline in non-farm payroll growth below 100k signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate hiring, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 5.0 and PAYEMS < 100.0 in same month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal produces positive returns in > 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) growth above 3.0% annualized, combined with stable inflation (CPIAUCSL < 200.0), signals a strong and sustainable economic expansion, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive in interaction-triggered periods (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal has Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
